candidates.head: a7214701f7e3fc0558ee201bcf8552069a803a55
candidates.claim: A form model with a constructor-parameter or `required` file-list member now fails to bind when no file is uploaded. A class whose only bound members are file lists now maps to null.
candidates.effect: Before, `found=true` and the model bound with an empty list. Now `found=false`, so ReportMissingValues (FormDataParameterMetadata.Required => true; `required` members via FormDataMetadataFactory) raises "Missing required value for constructor parameter 'Files'". Minimal APIs return 400 (no ErrorHandler → FormDataMappingException → WasParamCheckFailure). Blazor shows a form-mapping error. For a class with only file properties, `localFoundValueVar` stays false and the handler receives null instead of an instance.
candidates.repro: `record Upload(string Name, IReadOnlyList<IFormFile> Files);` `app.MapPost("/u", ([FromForm] Upload u) => u.Name).DisableAntiforgery();` Then POST multipart with `Name=a` and no file selected (an empty file input sends filename="", which FormFeature treats as a non-file field). The Blazor SSR equivalent is `[SupplyParameterFromForm]` with `IReadOnlyList<IBrowserFile>`.
